newsitem.title: USA: Sears buys $100 mln pest control business.
newsitem.headline: Sears buys $100 mln pest control business.

text.p: Sears, Roebuck and Co said Tuesday it completed acquisition of All America Termite and Pest Control Inc, a privately held termite and pest control business with 1996 revenue of more than $100 million.
All America, based in Orlando, Fla., has operated as a licensee of Sears saince 1982. Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

"Sears Home Services is committed to aggressive growth," said Jane Thompson, president of Sears Home Services. "The acquisition of All America positions us for strong growth in this segment. Today Sears Home Services is the largest player in a fragmented $160 billion home services market," she said in a statement.
Sears operates more than 800 department stores and more than 2,500 free-standing off-the-mall stores. It also offers home related services including home improvments.
Shares of Sears were trading up 3/4 to 55.
